note: The million-entry corpus is generated from compact phrase/response templates at runtime or during a build step. This avoids storing hundreds of MB of redundant JSON in Git while still providing one million distinct indexed pattern combinations.
generationRules: Combine a base trigger with wording variants without changing meaning.
Attach optional casual Japanese particles and conversational endings.
Select compatible response variants rather than random unrelated responses.
Deduplicate identical trigger/response pairs before indexing.
Do not encode sensitive personal information into generated patterns.
